description: Per-property franchise royalties owed to New Again Houses on each property deal. Holds four royalty components (acquisition, disposition, delayed fee, true-up); each carries a system-computed amount, an optional manual override that supersedes the computed value, an amount and date actually paid, a due date, and an outstanding 'Due' balance. Plus header/config fields controlling the royalty version, when the royalty is charged, and the median-sale-price cap.

PropertyId.meaning: Identifier of the property this royalty record belongs to; one royalty row per property.
PropertyId.use_when: Joining royalty figures to a specific property or its inventory/summary records.

LockedInMedianSalePriceMax.meaning: The U.S. median sale price snapshotted for this property and used to cap the maximum royalty (for royalty v4/v5 the cap = royalty percent x this value); locked in at first calculation so later changes to the national median don't move this property's cap.
LockedInMedianSalePriceMax.use_when: Explaining why a property's royalty was capped, or what maximum-royalty figure applies to it.
LockedInMedianSalePriceMax.do_not_use_for: The property's own sale price or ARV — this is a national median benchmark used only as a cap input.
LockedInMedianSalePriceMax.question: I think LockedInMedianSalePriceMax is the U.S. median home sale price we freeze per property and multiply by the royalty percent to cap the maximum royalty — right, or what is it?

LockedInMedianSalePriceMaxSetDate.meaning: Timestamp when LockedInMedianSalePriceMax was locked in for this property.
LockedInMedianSalePriceMaxSetDate.use_when: Showing how current the locked-in median cap is for a property.

RoyaltyVersionOverride.meaning: Manual override of the royalty version (1-5) for this property; the version sets the royalty percentage (v1 3%, v2 2.5%, v3 2.75%, v4 2%, v5 2.25%), the cap rules, and whether royalty is charged at acquisition or disposition. When null, the territory's default version applies.
RoyaltyVersionOverride.use_when: Explaining which royalty rate/rules a property runs under, or confirming a manual version change.
RoyaltyVersionOverride.do_not_use_for: Assuming this is always populated — most properties run the territory default and leave this null.
RoyaltyVersionOverride.question: I think RoyaltyVersionOverride manually forces the royalty version (1-5) that sets the percentage and cap rules, overriding the territory default — right, or what is it?

RoyaltyPaidAtOverride.meaning: Manual override of when the royalty is charged for this property: 'ACQUISITION' (when NAH buys) or 'DISPOSITION' (when NAH sells). When null, the territory default is used; versions 1-3 are always disposition, and the overall default is acquisition.
RoyaltyPaidAtOverride.use_when: Explaining whether a property's royalty is owed at purchase or at sale.
RoyaltyPaidAtOverride.do_not_use_for: Determining the amount owed — this only controls timing (which component applies), not the dollar figure.
RoyaltyPaidAtOverride.question: I think RoyaltyPaidAtOverride forces whether royalty is charged at acquisition (purchase) or disposition (sale), overriding the territory default — right, or what is it?

Calculated_AcquisitionRoyalty.meaning: System-computed acquisition royalty (royalty percent x property ARV, capped at the max) owed when the property's royalty is charged at acquisition; null when royalty is charged at disposition.
Calculated_AcquisitionRoyalty.use_when: Reporting the base computed acquisition royalty for a property charged at purchase.
Calculated_AcquisitionRoyalty.do_not_use_for: The amount owed now (use Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDue); the final amount when a manual override exists (use AcquisitionRoyaltyOverride).
Calculated_AcquisitionRoyalty.prefer_instead: AcquisitionRoyaltyOverride when an override may be set; Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDue for the outstanding balance.

AcquisitionRoyaltyOverride.meaning: Manual override of the acquisition royalty amount; when non-null it supersedes Calculated_AcquisitionRoyalty in all downstream due/true-up math.
AcquisitionRoyaltyOverride.use_when: Reporting the effective acquisition royalty when a human has manually set it.
AcquisitionRoyaltyOverride.do_not_use_for: Assuming it is always present — it is null unless someone manually overrode the computed amount.

AcquisitionRoyaltyPaid.meaning: Acquisition royalty amount actually paid to NAH for this property.
AcquisitionRoyaltyPaid.use_when: Reporting how much acquisition royalty has been collected.

Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDueDate.meaning: Date the acquisition royalty is due: the property's purchase date, or the contracted purchase date if not yet purchased.
Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDueDate.use_when: Showing when a property's acquisition royalty came or comes due.

AcquisitionRoyaltyPaidDate.meaning: Date the acquisition royalty was actually paid.
AcquisitionRoyaltyPaidDate.use_when: Reporting when acquisition royalty was collected.

Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDue.meaning: Outstanding acquisition royalty balance. Unlike the other components, this is treated as all-or-nothing: it is 0 once any payment is recorded, otherwise it equals the effective amount (AcquisitionRoyaltyOverride if set, else Calculated_AcquisitionRoyalty); it does not net out partial payments.
Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDue.use_when: Answering how much acquisition royalty a property still owes right now.
Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDue.do_not_use_for: Assuming it subtracts partial payments — any recorded payment zeroes it out.
Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDue.question: I think Calculated_AcquisitionRoyaltyDue is the acquisition royalty still owed, and it drops to 0 as soon as any payment is recorded rather than netting partial payments — right, or should it subtract partial payments like the disposition side?

Calculated_DispositionRoyalty.meaning: System-computed disposition royalty (royalty percent x property ARV, capped at the max) owed when the property's royalty is charged at disposition/sale; also the path used by legacy versions 1-3. Null when royalty is charged at acquisition.
Calculated_DispositionRoyalty.use_when: Reporting the base computed disposition royalty for a property charged at sale.
Calculated_DispositionRoyalty.do_not_use_for: The amount owed now (use Calculated_DispositionRoyaltyDue); the final amount when a manual override exists (use DispositionRoyaltyOverride).
Calculated_DispositionRoyalty.prefer_instead: DispositionRoyaltyOverride when an override may be set; Calculated_DispositionRoyaltyDue for the outstanding balance.

DispositionRoyaltyOverride.meaning: Manual override of the disposition royalty amount; when non-null it supersedes Calculated_DispositionRoyalty in the due calculation.
DispositionRoyaltyOverride.use_when: Reporting the effective disposition royalty when a human has manually set it.
DispositionRoyaltyOverride.do_not_use_for: Assuming it is always present — it is null unless someone manually overrode the computed amount.

DispositionRoyaltyPaid.meaning: Disposition royalty amount actually paid to NAH for this property.
DispositionRoyaltyPaid.use_when: Reporting how much disposition royalty has been collected.

Calculated_DispositionRoyaltyDueDate.meaning: Date the disposition royalty is due: the property's actual sell date, or the contracted/expected sell date if not yet sold.
Calculated_DispositionRoyaltyDueDate.use_when: Showing when a property's disposition royalty came or comes due.

DispositionRoyaltyPaidDate.meaning: Date the disposition royalty was actually paid.
DispositionRoyaltyPaidDate.use_when: Reporting when disposition royalty was collected.

Calculated_DispositionRoyaltyDue.meaning: Outstanding disposition royalty balance = effective amount (DispositionRoyaltyOverride if set, else Calculated_DispositionRoyalty) minus DispositionRoyaltyPaid.
Calculated_DispositionRoyaltyDue.use_when: Answering how much disposition royalty a property still owes right now.
Calculated_DispositionRoyaltyDue.do_not_use_for: The originally computed amount (use Calculated_DispositionRoyalty) — this nets out what's been paid.

Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee.meaning: A flat $2,000 fee the engine sets when a property's royalty is charged at disposition under royalty v4/v5; appears to penalize deferring the royalty to sale rather than paying at acquisition.
Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee.use_when: Reporting the delayed royalty fee assessed on a disposition-charged property.
Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee.do_not_use_for: The amount owed now (use Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFeeDue); the final amount when an override exists (use DelayedRoyaltyFeeOverride).
Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee.prefer_instead: DelayedRoyaltyFeeOverride when an override may be set; Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFeeDue for the outstanding balance.
Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee.question: I think the delayed royalty fee is a flat $2,000 charged on v4/v5 properties whose royalty is paid at disposition instead of at acquisition — right, or what actually triggers it (e.g., holding a property too long)?

DelayedRoyaltyFeeOverride.meaning: Manual override of the delayed royalty fee amount; when non-null it supersedes Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee in the due calculation.
DelayedRoyaltyFeeOverride.use_when: Reporting the effective delayed fee when a human has manually set it.
DelayedRoyaltyFeeOverride.do_not_use_for: Assuming it is always present — it is null unless someone manually overrode the computed fee.

DelayedRoyaltyFeePaid.meaning: Delayed royalty fee amount actually paid to NAH for this property.
DelayedRoyaltyFeePaid.use_when: Reporting how much of the delayed fee has been collected.

Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFeeDueDate.meaning: Date the delayed royalty fee is due; set equal to the disposition royalty due date (actual or contracted sell date).
Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFeeDueDate.use_when: Showing when a property's delayed royalty fee came or comes due.

DelayedRoyaltyFeePaidDate.meaning: Date the delayed royalty fee was actually paid.
DelayedRoyaltyFeePaidDate.use_when: Reporting when the delayed fee was collected.

Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFeeDue.meaning: Outstanding delayed royalty fee balance = effective amount (DelayedRoyaltyFeeOverride if set, else Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee) minus DelayedRoyaltyFeePaid.
Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFeeDue.use_when: Answering how much of the delayed royalty fee a property still owes right now.
Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFeeDue.do_not_use_for: The originally assessed fee (use Calculated_DelayedRoyaltyFee) — this nets out what's been paid.

Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp.meaning: Reconciliation amount = the final computed total royalty (Calculated_Inv_Royalty) minus what was already paid on the applicable component (acquisition or disposition royalty paid); captures the shortfall (or overage) when the final royalty differs from what was collected earlier, e.g. after ARV changes.
Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp.use_when: Explaining an adjustment between the final royalty owed and what was previously paid.
Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp.do_not_use_for: The amount owed now (use Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUpDue); the base royalty (use the acquisition/disposition royalty fields).
Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp.prefer_instead: RoyaltyTrueUpOverride when an override may be set; Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUpDue for the outstanding balance.
Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp.question: I think the royalty true-up reconciles the final computed royalty against what was already paid (final royalty minus amount paid), so we catch shortfalls when ARV or the final number changes — right, or what does it reconcile against?

RoyaltyTrueUpOverride.meaning: Manual override of the royalty true-up amount; when non-null it supersedes Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp in the due calculation.
RoyaltyTrueUpOverride.use_when: Reporting the effective true-up when a human has manually set it.
RoyaltyTrueUpOverride.do_not_use_for: Assuming it is always present — it is null unless someone manually overrode the computed true-up.

RoyaltyTrueUpPaid.meaning: Royalty true-up amount actually paid to NAH for this property.
RoyaltyTrueUpPaid.use_when: Reporting how much of the true-up has been collected.

Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUpDueDate.meaning: Date the royalty true-up is due; set equal to the disposition royalty due date (actual or contracted sell date).
Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUpDueDate.use_when: Showing when a property's true-up came or comes due.

RoyaltyTrueUpPaidDate.meaning: Date the royalty true-up was actually paid.
RoyaltyTrueUpPaidDate.use_when: Reporting when the true-up was collected.

Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUpDue.meaning: Outstanding royalty true-up balance = effective amount (RoyaltyTrueUpOverride if set, else Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp) minus RoyaltyTrueUpPaid.
Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUpDue.use_when: Answering how much of the true-up a property still owes right now.
Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUpDue.do_not_use_for: The originally computed true-up (use Calculated_RoyaltyTrueUp) — this nets out what's been paid.
